subject: Two-day pipeline stitch — last-mile asks & verification
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Two-day pipeline stitch — last-mile asks & verification

Team —

We have ~48 hours before finance runs the next official forecast sweep. I need a tight, verified pass on all deals you have in "Commit" or late-stage "Verifying" so we don't over/understate the number. Please do the following by EOD PDT tomorrow: 

- Update the attached pipeline-rollup.csv with a single line per deal (deal id, stage, $ARR, expected close date, blockers).
- Confirm whether any signed docs are outstanding (DocuSign or SOW) and upload a stub to the thread (filename OK).
- For deals with procurement dependencies (cloud/legal/proc), add a one-line note on status and estimated days to clear.

Quick rules of thumb: if legal needs a material contract redline or procurement hasn't shared PO terms, mark as "Verifying" not "Commit." Finance will only treat "Commit" lines as allowed to flow into the 48-hour close.

Priority list (please call out any changes inline):
1) ArrowTech — Elena indicated exec sign-off this morning but procurement still has open questions on data residency.
2) NimbleCloud renewal — procurement email pending; CS owns technical signoff.
3) VegaHealth expansion — awaiting internal PO from client (finance hold)

I'm looping finance and forecasting after we collect the rollup; they'll run an adjusted forecast at 15:00 PDT tomorrow. If you hit any blockers that require escalation (discount approvals, credit exceptions, SLA asks), flag me and CC Sean.

Attachments: pipeline-rollup.csv (stub)

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>

Thanks Markus — quick status from my side (updating CSV now and attaching SOW stub):

- ArrowTech (DEAL-3012): Exec sign-off confirmed by Elena on phone at 09:20. Procurement has two items: (1) KMS integration language; (2) data-retention clause. Elena expects procurement turnaround 3 business days, but she asked me to send a redline to help speed it. I attached arrowtech-sow.pdf (stub) with the redline requests highlighted.
- NimbleCloud (RENEW-188): Still "Verifying" — procurement asked for a bank reference; they are waiting on NimbleCloud legal to reply. Estimated 5–7 business days.
- VegaHealth (EXP-44): Customer sent signed LOI but accounting hasn't issued PO. CS is chasing.

Ask: If ArrowTech procurement pushes past the forecast sweep window, we should move it to "Verifying" for the 15:00 run and add a comment for finance. Elena — can you confirm procurement's SLA or share the right contact?

Attachments: arrowtech-sow.pdf (redline stub)

—
Marissa Cole

Markus / Marissa —

Appreciate the details. Two operational notes: 

- For renewals with procurement friction (NimbleCloud), Treasury prefers we get an explicit procurement ETA or PO before we call it Commit. I'll mark RENEW-188 as "Verifying" in the CSV and add nimblecloud-procurement-note.msg as a reference.
- If ArrowTech asks for an SLA exception tied to on-prem deployment, leadership needs a short justification to approve any discount. If Marissa can capture the ask in one sentence and estimated revenue impact, I'll route to legal/finance for an exception decision.

I expect to reconcile the rollup with Finance by 14:30 PDT; please be timely.

—

Thanks all — great, clear updates. Final asks before 15:00 PDT run: 

- Marissa: if ArrowTech procurement cannot commit to <=72 hours turnaround, change DEAL-3012 to "Verifying" and note reason (KMS/data-retention). If they can, keep as "Commit" and upload any signed docs.
- Lauren: send me the one-line discount justification if legal approval will be required. I'll escalate to Nick and finance.
- Sean: please confirm there are no outstanding finance holds on VegaHealth; if there are, list them in the CSV under "Finance Notes."

Finance will treat only rows marked as "Commit" in the attached CSV as candidate ARR for the adjusted forecast. I will run one last human sanity check at 14:50 and then trigger the forecast ingestion at 15:00 PDT.

HubSpot: please update the deal stages before 14:30 — https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456/view_all

If anything materially changes after 14:30, call me (cell) and CC finance-forecasting@redwood.com.
